conversion_rule: DOA P/K/F+G buttons + numpad directions -> Tekken-style 1/2/3/4 + directions. P=1, K=3 with limb alternation 1/2 (arms), 3/4 (legs) on multi-hit strings. Numpad 8/2/4/6/9/7/3/1 = u/d/b/f/u/f/u/b/d/f/d/b. 66=f,f. 236=qcf, 214=qcb, 41236=hcf, 360=360. F+P throw = 1+3. F+G counter holds = 1+2. F+P+K attacks = 1+2. Colliding inputs get a ~variant suffix on the key only; entry.input keeps the true Tekken input.
limb_convention: 1=armR, 2=armL, 3=legL, 4=legR; input keys prefixed ~ are dictionary variants sharing an input
